visual_checks.evidence: PNG MD5-identical to iter-045/048 (hero/side/top all match).

reasoning: PNG bit-identical to iter-045 (MD5 match all 3 views). Kernel: 26.3485 → 26.321 ms (-0.10%). Extended iter-048's pattern to 3-way: one mul_tiles_init(CB_DX, CB_DX) followed by THREE mul_tiles calls — (DX,DX), (DY,DY), and (DX,DY). The cross-CB pairing (DX,DY) in the third call did NOT need re-init — proving the safe pattern extends to mixed CB pairs of the same format. Saves 2 acquires per Gaussian (was 3 separate B2a/B2b/B2c acquires). Down to ~5 acquires/Gaussian (B1, B2-fused, B3b/C, D1, D2+E). PERF gain is small in absolute terms but it's a clean bit-identical improvement and a strong pattern unlock for further fusion.
